canonical_fold_source.definition: For each (category, garment_identity), canonical test fold is the unique H3 row with split == 'test'.

explicitly_excluded_fold_source.reason: Distinct corrective identity namespace; invalid for direct cross-namespace S01 fold assignment.

global_collision_rule.identity_constraint: No two sentinels may come from the same garment identity.
global_collision_rule.procedure: For each role in frozen selection order, sort by that role's primary metric and stable tie key; scan until the first candidate whose garment identity has not already been used.

historical_population.selection_universe: Frozen V3 CROP_ONLY / Paper-II historical sketch universe

percentile_convention.s01_rule: Compute percentile coordinates over full valid 2300-sketch population first; then restrict candidates to identities whose canonical H3 test fold is 3.

S01.eligible_pool: Sketches whose canonical H3 identity test fold == 3
S01.name: Fold-3 representative

validity_rule: A sketch is valid only if it passed already-existing historical QA required to compute the role metric and all required values are finite. No new eligibility threshold may be invented during selection.
